ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Adroit Infotech Limited's Board approved a significant strategic overhaul, including a proposed name change to 'Verso Altima Group Limited,' a substantial acquisition of 60% of Croatia-based Verso Altima d.o.o. for up to €7 million to drive European expansion, and a preferential issuance of 1 crore convertible warrants to the promoter and promoter group for ₹13 crore. These moves signal a major international business transformation, but the relatively modest capital raise from warrants against the large acquisition cost (up to ~₹63 Cr) raises questions about the complete funding strategy for this significant foreign investment, implying potential further capital needs beyond stated internal accruals.
